g.text: ClinicBook - Fioralba Zika domain model (cancellation and daily schedule)
Status BOOKED is the active booking.
Status CANCELLED is retained history and releases the slot.
cancel needs: status BOOKED, start in the future, and either
owner patient at least 24 h before start, or any receptionist
Lifetime association to Appointment is 0..* because records are kept.
Future active bookings are the subset with status BOOKED and start later than now.
FR-05 constraint: that subset has at most 2 members, checked on each booking.
Cancelled appointments do not count (proposed acceptance rule).
FR-17: a patient may not hold overlapping BOOKED appointments (Should).
FR-09 (Should): 3 no-shows in the last 90 days allow booking only through reception.
The source of no-show records is not defined in the shared documents (open question).
Slots are 20 minutes, 08:00-16:00, Monday to Friday (FR-02).
A slot is free only if future, not blocked, and without a BOOKED appointment.
FR-04: at most one BOOKED appointment per doctor and start time.
A slot inside a blocked period is not offered as free
FR-07: view own non-cancelled appointments for a chosen day,
in chronological order. Each entry shows time, patient name and status.
